caption: The drawing depicts a single standing figure resembling a carved wooden statue, which appears to be a robed male with a beard and mustache. The figure wears a long, dark blue garment adorned with scattered white patches and vertical strokes. A rope belt, tan in color, is tied around the waist, with the ends hanging down the front. The upper garment is a darker shade of blue, and the figure’s arms are bent at the elbows. The left hand is open and palm facing up, while the right hand holds a small black cross upright. The figure has light brown skin and is barefoot, standing on a brown rectangular base. The hair is dark with a lighter band at the base of a round hat or halo that has an orange and green checkered pattern. The background is plain, unadorned, and light tan in color. The drawing is signed at the bottom right corner.
title: Bulto, Priest Carrying Cross and Skull
